odc_type: logic error in default value handling
observation_summary: Command-line options with default values ignore those defaults if the user provides fewer arguments than the maximum allowed, rather than filling the remaining slots with the defaults.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the command-line parser fails to merge default values with user-provided arguments when the number of provided arguments is less than the maximum allowed but greater than zero. The original implementation only considered default values if the user provided no arguments at all. The fix modifies the logic to check if the number of provided values is less than the number of available default values, and if so, appends the remaining default values to the user-provided list.
